quotations.old_english: In Cassinum þǽre stówe (þ-bar; stoc, þám stocwíc, v. ll.)
Þe&yogh;&yogh; liccness off Cherubyn o twe&yogh;&yogh;enn stokess metedd

source_text: stóc (stoc?). l. stoc, and add :-- Þ-bar; áborstene clif hreás ofdúneweard . . . and wæs farende oþ þ-bar; hit cóm þǽr hit mynte feallan ofer þ-bar; mynster, and þ-bar; þonne wǽre hryre ealles þæs stoces (stówes. v. l.) and forwyrd ealra þǽra bróðra ingentis saxi moles erupta est, quae . . . veniens totius ruinam cellae, omniumque fratrum interitum minabatur, Gr. D. 12, 12. In Cassinum þǽre stówe (þ-bar; stoc, þám stocwíc, v. ll.) in Cassinum castrum, 172, 5. [I faderr stoke, Orm. 9778.]Þe&yogh;&yogh; liccness off Cherubyn o twe&yogh;&yogh;enn stokess metedd, 1049.]
